description.text:
Warning! This protocol is EXPERIMENTAL and under active development.
It may change at any time, including in backward-incompatible ways,
without incrementing the interface major version and without prior
notice. No compatibility guarantees of any kind are provided. Clients
and compositors must track the upstream definition in treeland-protocols
and must not rely on the current interface names, requests, events, or
semantics remaining stable across releases.

This protocol allows a privileged DDE client such as the dock or
shell to place XWayland windows on the compositor: moving an
XWayland window identified by its X11 window ID to a position
relative to another surface.

The compositor should reject bind attempts from non-privileged
clients.

The terms "must", "must not", "should", and "may" in this document
are to be interpreted as described in RFC 2119.
description.summary: XWayland window placement control for treeland

description.text:
A global that exposes XWayland window placement actions to a
privileged DDE client.

The compositor should reject bind attempts from non-privileged
clients.

This interface is stateless: each request is an independent
one-shot action. The compositor does not send events on this
interface; set_xwindow_position_relative reports its result
through a per-request wl_callback.

Request that the compositor move the XWayland window
identified by the X11 window ID wid so that its top-left
point is placed at the anchor surface's top-left point
offset by (dx, dy).

Once the compositor has finished processing, it sends the
done event to the callback and destroys the callback. The
callback data is 0 when the move succeeded, and 1 when it
failed, for example because no XWayland window with the
given wid is currently mapped or the anchor surface is
invalid.

The compositor may apply the new position asynchronously.
description.summary: move an XWayland window relative to a surface

args.name: dx
args.summary: horizontal offset from the anchor top-left point

args.name: dy
args.summary: vertical offset from the anchor top-left point
